manual_visual_review.finding: Top-6 node labels overlap nodes and one another near the graph center; several labels are truncated to visually ambiguous prefixes.

The network captions say the 101 omitted isolated nodes' source composition is shown in the community-composition figure, but fig3 filters to non-trivial communities (n>=2), so it does not show singleton/isolated-node composition.
The caption says the diverging ARI scale has 0 as white, while the rendered scale maps 0 to blue and approximately 0.5 to white.
The caption does not remind readers that E1 ranks only 44 compounds while E2/E3 rank 227; the displayed Jaccard values are therefore coverage-asymmetric.

overall: PNG/PDF packaging is complete, but three material label/caption issues require revision before publication.
